name: Solid Power, Inc. (Nasdaq: SLDP)
analyst_actions: 2026-09-22 | H.C. Wainwright | maintains Buy | Buy->Buy, price target $7
2026-08-05 | Alliance Global Partners | reiterates Buy | Buy->Buy, price target $6.75
2026-07-17 | Weiss Ratings | reiterated Sell | Sell->Sell, no price target, D-
product: Sulfide-based solid electrolyte material plus licensed cell designs and manufacturing processes; it sells materials rather than cells. Footprint is SP1 Louisville, Colorado for pilot cell production and SP2 Thornton, Colorado for pilot electrolyte production and testing, with a Seoul office; 30 MT annual electrolyte capacity today, targeting 75 MT by year-end 2026.
demand: Customer sampling and partner evaluation are underway with BMW, SK On and Samsung SDI, and the deck claims industry leaders chose sulfide chemistry; but no volume electrolyte contracts, bookings or named production commitments are disclosed. Demand is still pilot and evaluation stage, with EV the near-term market and robotics, mining, defense and aviation as optionality.
pricing_power: Unproven and effectively absent so far: there is no material electrolyte revenue, and the Q2 2026 negative revenue line with a $1.2M catch-up reversal shows economics set by partner milestone assumptions. Management frames the value path as cost per kilogram falling with scale rather than as pricing power today.
competition: Other all-solid-state battery developers and large cell makers; the deck cites sulfide as 50 percent of global ASSB technology selection versus polymer, oxide and hybrid. Solid Power claims an edge through a scalable wet process retaining 70-80 percent of roll-to-roll lithium-ion process, and says it does not compete as a cell manufacturer with its own customers.
team: CEO and President John Van Scoter; CFO, Treasurer and Secretary Linda Heller; CTO Josh Buettner-Garrett; EVP Product Development and Delivery Lauren McCabe; EVP Strategic Technical Advisor Berislav Blizanac; Andreas Maier heads Solid Power Korea. Uwe Breitweg, BMW Group VP Powertrain, Emission and Battery Strategy, joined the board on 2026-07-01 under BMW Holding B.V. nomination rights, replacing Dr. Feurer. About 235 employees.
market_strategy: Capital-light partner model: supply electrolyte to OEMs and Tier 1 cell manufacturers and license cell designs and processes instead of building cells, using a debt-free balance sheet. Manufacturing scale and market access are meant to come through a Korean joint venture, with continuous wet-process production and ISO 9001 certification supporting commercial readiness.
bull: Sulfide chemistry chosen by BMW, SK On, Samsung SDI; 30 MT capacity today, 75 MT targeted Q4 2026; $419.3M liquidity funds the runway; H.C. Wainwright maintained Buy with a $7 target on 2026-09-22.
bear: Q2 2026 revenue and grant income was negative $0.3M versus $7.5M a year earlier, with a $1.2M milestone reversal; H1 fell to $2.8M from $13.6M; no JV signed, only talks; $30.3M quarterly operating loss and share count up to 227.2M.
falsifier: If no Korean commercial-scale electrolyte JV is announced by 2026-12-31, or the continuous pilot line misses its Q4 2026 startup, the management timeline is broken.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 (Aug 4): revenue and grant income negative $0.3M vs $7.5M year earlier, including a $1.2M milestone revenue reversal; SK On Line Installation Agreement completed with milestone paid, new collaboration being negotiated; Korea commercial-scale electrolyte JV talks advancing; continuous pilot line targets Q4 2026 startup; FY26 cash investment guided $85-100M; liquidity $419.3M.
web_not_known_yesterday: not found - newest disclosure is the 2026-09-14 8-K furnishing the September 2026 investor presentation tied to the 2026-09-15 H.C. Wainwright conference; no filing or press release dated 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25 was found on EDGAR or the IR news page.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Not volume, not price: H1 2026 revenue and grant income of $2.8M came from SK On collaboration milestones and U.S. DOE grant income, down from $13.6M. Mix is shifting from milestones and licensing toward electrolyte supply, but Q2 showed a $1.2M catch-up revenue reversal from changed milestone assumptions, so reported growth is milestone timing.
web_suppliers: not found - no suppliers are named in the filings read. Management cites raw material and precursor costs, supplier scale-up as a cost lever, and Q1 2026 opex reduction driven by timing of supplier and material shipments; degree of supplier constraint is undisclosed.
web_customers: BMW, SK On and Samsung SDI (joint evaluation agreement), plus the U.S. Department of Energy as grant counterparty. Extremely concentrated: essentially all H1 2026 revenue and grant income came from SK On milestones and the DOE grant; electrolyte is supplied and cell designs are licensed to SK On (Korean line) and BMW (German prototype line, i7 test vehicle).
web_who_loses: Inference from the filings, not a stated claim: incumbent lithium-ion electrolyte and separator suppliers, rival sulfide and oxide ASSB developers racing Solid Power to qualify with the same OEMs, and any OEM in-house solid-state program that gets leapfrogged if licensed Solid Power chemistry becomes the industry default.
web_contradicting_evidence: Revenue collapsed: Q2 2026 total revenue and grant income negative $0.3M vs $7.5M a year earlier, H1 $2.8M vs $13.6M; a $1.2M revenue reversal on revised milestone assumptions; no JV signed yet, only negotiations; $30.3M quarterly operating loss funded by balance sheet; share count rose to 227.2M at June 30 2026 from 201.2M at Dec 31 2025 via the $130M offering.
web_if_management_right: Continuous pilot line is validated in Q4 2026 reaching 75 MT annual capacity, a Korean commercial-scale electrolyte JV is announced by year-end 2026, ISO 9001 is completed, then 500 MT pre-commercial and a 2,000-plus MT commercial plant (about 4 GWh) with falling cost per kilogram; electrolyte supply becomes the primary revenue line and margins scale by stacking repeat production units.
web_if_management_wrong: Cash breaks first: FY26 cash investment of $85-100M against $419.3M liquidity and roughly $30M quarterly operating expense with negligible revenue. If the Korea JV slips, or SK On, BMW and Samsung SDI programs stall or terminate, milestone revenue stays negative, revenues near consensus $5.5M FY26, and equity dilution resumes to fund the runway.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Equipment and dry-room vendors for the continuous line, sulfide and precursor lithium material suppliers, the German and Korean cell manufacturing ecosystems around BMW, SK On and Samsung SDI, the Department of Energy grant program, and adjacent end markets named in the deck: robotics, off-highway and mining, oil and gas, defense and aviation.
